vulnerable_code:
@router.post("/billing/reauth-token/update-payout")
async def update_payout_bank_details(
    reauth_token: str = Query(...),
    target_merchant_id: str = Body(..., embed=True),
    bank_details: BankAccountPayload = Body(...),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    stmt = select(ReauthActionToken).where(
        ReauthActionToken.token == reauth_token,
        ReauthActionToken.action == "PAYOUT_UPDATE",
        ReauthActionToken.expires_at > datetime.utcnow()
    )
    token_record = await db.scalar(stmt)
    if not token_record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired re-authentication token")

    merchant = await db.scalar(
        select(MerchantProfile).where(MerchantProfile.id == target_merchant_id)
    )
    if not merchant:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Merchant profile not found")

    merchant.payout_iban = bank_details.iban
    merchant.payout_bic = bank_details.bic
    await db.commit()

    return {"status": "payout_updated", "merchant_id": target_merchant_id}
diagnosis: The endpoint requires a reauth_token to modify sensitive merchant payout banking details. However, it applies the IBAN change to target_merchant_id supplied in the request body rather than verifying that token_record.merchant_id matches target_merchant_id. An attacker with a reauth token for their own merchant profile can overwrite the payout destination of another merchant.

corrected_code:
@router.post("/billing/reauth-token/update-payout")
async def update_payout_bank_details(
    reauth_token: str = Query(...),
    target_merchant_id: str = Body(..., embed=True),
    bank_details: BankAccountPayload = Body(...),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    stmt = select(ReauthActionToken).where(
        ReauthActionToken.token == reauth_token,
        ReauthActionToken.action == "PAYOUT_UPDATE",
        ReauthActionToken.expires_at > datetime.utcnow()
    )
    token_record = await db.scalar(stmt)
    if not token_record or token_record.merchant_id != target_merchant_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid re-authentication token or merchant mismatch")

    merchant = await db.scalar(
        select(MerchantProfile).where(MerchantProfile.id == target_merchant_id)
    )
    if not merchant:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Merchant profile not found")

    merchant.payout_iban = bank_details.iban
    merchant.payout_bic = bank_details.bic
    await db.commit()

    return {"status": "payout_updated", "merchant_id": target_merchant_id}
